learning_objective: 🎯 We will explore all the wonderful things we see on the road while going to school!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every morning we go from our home to our school. The journey is full of interesting things to look at.
On the road we might see big green trees colourful shops cars and little dogs. We also meet our friends on the way.

fun_activity.title: 🗺️ Draw Your Path
fun_activity.instructions: Draw your house on one side of a paper and your school on the other. Now draw three things you see on the road between them!

quick_recap: ⭐ The path between home and school is full of surprises.
⭐ We see shops trees and vehicles on the road.
⭐ We travel to school by walking taking a bus or sitting on a cycle.
